summary: Authored spec lens A for control-room-ui-views containing the capability-to-file map and observable RFC 2119 requirement definitions. Specified four new full capabilities (batch-wave-view, feature-lease-monitor, reconciliation-workspace, lane-envelope-inspector) and one modified delta capability (approvals-web-ui).

hard_stops.hard_stop: The proposal has no Capabilities section and no Affected Areas section to infer one from.
A capability the proposal names as Modified has no live spec in openspec/specs/, so it is really new and the proposal is wrong about which.
A requirement cannot be stated without deciding an implementation detail the design phase has not decided.
Satisfying one instruction in this packet would require violating another.

files_changed.why: Spec lens A defining capability mapping and requirement set for control-room-ui-views.

done_criteria.criterion: Every capability-map row is classified new or existing, and every "existing" row cites the live spec with file:line that resolves in this worktree.
done_criteria.evidence: openspec/changes/control-room-ui-views/spec-lens-a.md:12-18 maps approvals-web-ui (existing, citing openspec/specs/approvals-web-ui/spec.md:26-83), batch-wave-view (new), feature-lease-monitor (new), reconciliation-workspace (new), and lane-envelope-inspector (new).

done_criteria.criterion: Every requirement carries an RFC 2119 keyword and states observable behavior rather than implementation.
done_criteria.evidence: openspec/changes/control-room-ui-views/spec-lens-a.md:22-50 defines requirements using MUST / MUST NOT with terminal consumers at internal/serve/handlers.go:36-118, internal/serve/model.go:26-125, and internal/serve/static/app.js:22-70.
